excerpt: Today: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash varies 29× in price across providers → LLM API prices, ranked by your monthly bill The cheapest price per token is often not the cheapest bill. CostPerToken ranks every provider of a model by what your traffic would cost each month. Prices checked 27 Nov 2026. Or price your own traffic Biggest price gaps today Same model, same workload, a different provider. Each card is today’s cheapest and dearest monthly bill for the sample support bot. Open one to see every route. Every route of a model, priced for one workload A preview with the Support bot sample: 300,000 requests a month, 2,000 tokens in, 400 out, half cached. Left, each model’s cheapest route. Right, all six routes for Claude Opus 5.5. See every Claude Opus 5.5 route - GPT-6 LunaOpenAI6 routes$46.50 - DeepSeek V4.1 FlashDeepInfra39 routes$74.93 - Claude Haiku 5.5Google5 routes$93.00 - Mistral Large 4Mistral2 routes$483.00 - Gemini 4 CarbonGoogle AI Studio5 routes$915.00 - Claude Sonnet 5.5Google5 routes$1,830.00 - GPT-6.2 SolGoogle6 routes$1,830.00 - Claude Opus 5.5Amazon Bedrock6 routes$3,660.00 Prices per 1M tokens. Month counts input, output and cache reads; cache writes are not priced in yet. One Anthropic listing bills double, and OpenRouter does not say why. Every price shows its source Each row links where the price came from and the day we checked it. A price we cannot trace to a source is left off the list. Emails you when a price drops Name the model you run. When a provider changes that model’s price, you get one email with the old and new price. - DeepSeek V4.1 FlashCheapest route: DeepInfra, $74.93 a month - Claude Opus 5.5Five clouds at $4 in, $20 out per 1M tokens - GPT-6 LunaCheapest model for Support bot, $46.50 a month Prices from labs, clouds and model hosts Anthropic and OpenAI beside the clouds that resell them, and the hosts that run open models.
